notes.cooccurrence: the paper's dual-task metric, transposed: at caption positions where the instructed concept is in the J-lens top-10, P(an image-object category is also in the top-10), vs a shuffled control that re-draws which caption steps carry the concept indicator (same count); the paper's text-LLM values: concept+concept 0.46 (interleave), concept+computed-answer 0.09 (exclude)
notes.handoff: the handoff position is the LAST PROMPT token (the prefill forward's decoding position, whose distribution predicts generated token 0; the x14 step_records[0] convention) — here the row residual[-1] of the recorded prefill
notes.matcher: x13 detect_mentions matcher: one whole-sequence decode, lowercased, category names matched longest-first with word boundaries, optional (s|es) plural suffix, span masking (so 'hot dog' does not also match 'dog'); irregular plurals are a documented gap

interpretation_limits: the concept indicator uses the concept's emission token id only (last subword of ' ' + name); a caption paraphrase ('puppy') is invisible to the lens-side indicator and to the behavioral string match alike
the shuffled control permutes the concept indicator WITHIN one caption, so it tests temporal alignment, not cross-caption base rates
baseline runs use the concept assigned to the image (concepts[image_index % len(concepts)]), so the baseline concept rate is a spontaneous-rate contrast, not a per-concept controlled one
image-object categories use the image's COCO ground truth; a mentioned object outside the annotation set counts as neither concept nor visual hit
